CabinetBottom: width 1.34 -> 1.332 and y 0.59 -> 0.592 so its end faces and underside leave the cabinet walls' planes; SideRailRight/Left: z position 0.248 -> 0.246 so the outer face is 2 mm inside the side wall face; ScoreWindowGlass: depth 0.01 -> 0.011 at x -0.6265, y 0.955 -> 0.957, z size 0.40 -> 0.396 to leave the backglass, frame bottom and stile planes; SideDiscOuter/Inner: outer disc z 0.263 -> 0.265, inner disc z 0.264 -> 0.267 so they stand proud of the side stripes and of each other
